title: Zesty Gooey Norwegian Celery Casserole
description: A winey, gooey, and cozy Norwegian dish featuring celery, perfect for a cold winter night, and friendly to dairy-free diets.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large skillet, sauté the chopped onion and minced garlic until softened.
Add the chopped celery to the skillet and continue to cook until it starts to soften.
In a large bowl, whisk together the white wine, vegetable broth, and nutritional yeast.
Add the cooked celery mixture to the bowl and stir to combine.
In a separate bowl, mix together the score-fat and oat cream until well combined.
Add the score-fat mixture to the celery mixture and stir until a gooey consistency is achieved.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Transfer the mixture to a baking dish and bake for 25 minutes or until the top is lightly browned.
Remove from the oven and let cool for a few minutes before serving.
